correctedCritiques.pro-history-does-not-establish-miracles: Strongest feature: The reply distinguishes ordinary history from supernatural conclusions, uses Christian and Islamic examples, and connects that gap to the fairness of religious assent. Principal limitation: Developed miracle arguments use testimony, explanatory comparison, and cumulative context, not personal existence alone, so the response leaves the strongest opposing evidential formulation insufficiently examined. Live burden: Woodford must compare testimonial miracle hypotheses with natural alternatives and explain what publicly accessible revelation divine love requires, while Edwards must provide evidence commensurate with the extraordinary supernatural claims invoked. Locked score: The very-strong band reflects careful calibration, precise distinctions, broad responsiveness, and central relevance to salvation confusion, tempered by incomplete engagement with the best cumulative historical case for miracles.
correctedCritiques.con-guided-evolution-and-human-purpose: Strongest feature: The move distinguishes purpose from biological development, accepts natural selection as compatible with divine agency, and cautiously presents guided evolution as a qualified possibility. Principal limitation: Compatibility does not show guidance or intended humanity, while the purpose conclusion identifies no observations more expected under divine intention than under unguided selection. Live burden: Edwards must identify a comparative indicator of guidance or explain how the broader cumulative case warrants purposive interpretation, while addressing the evidential sufficiency of ordinary evolutionary mechanisms. Locked score: The strong/competent band recognizes coherence, qualification, conceptual flexibility, and constructive relevance to purpose, but retains a substantial evidential discount because neither intentional human existence nor divine guidance receives independent support from compatibility alone.
